title: Puzzle Rush is now live! Built entirely with Claude Code + Gemini.
author: Ukawok92
selftext:
Hello, my game Puzzle Rush was just published to the Google play store this morning and I'm very excited about it. (iOS version is currently being reviewed by Apple)

It was built on the Godot engine using Claude code, and Gemini for Art/Music. Been working hard on this around August, so about 3 months of development. I used Gemini for the Boss character designs and music. Happy to answer any questions about the development process of this game.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.puzzlerush.game

Anyone familiar with puzzle league games should enjoy this, it's packed full of features:

\\- Versus Mode: 12 animal rivals, each with their own 3D world. Chain combos to dump trash blocks on them to clear all 4 difficulties from easy to brutal.

\\- Online VS: Play head to head against players worldwide in real-time.

\\- Puzzle mode: hand-built puzzles across the solar system, Mercury to Pluto

\\- Endless, Time Trial and Speed Run modes with global leaderboards and replays of top runs

\\- Puzzle editor: make your own puzzles and share them with other players.

It also features controller support, swipe or button controls, colour-blind palettes and widescreen support for Android TV.

It's still in active development, so I'd really love feedback on everything and anything.

Thank you!
